label: A root with will and finite reach give GOD_4 the capacity of will (inference)
rule: Identify the named bearer with the actual root by finite grounding reach and transport will
meaning: The bundle supplies the actual root n at w and will of that same n. For each g satisfying IsGod, the open reach premise and n's roothood give g = n by namedRootOfReach on the same m and w. Transfer the same HasWill predicate by equality. This proof uses the bundle's actual-root and will conjuncts. The intellect-to-will application can warrant the will conjunct in upstream producers. Here the named conclusion is derived by identifying the bearer with the witness that already has will.
